title: Unify Projectile + Special into Single Class
why: Two classes (Projectile, Special) duplicate flight/rotation/render logic. Rock is awkwardly a 'typeless Special' when it should be a basic Projectile with gravity. Merging eliminates dual sprite init paths, dual pools, and the confusing typeless concept.
outcomes: One Projectile class handles all flying entities (thorn, rock, bomb, saw). One pool. One sprite pipeline. ballistic.js becomes a param config on projectile, not a separate primitive. Rock = default arcing projectile, same as thorn is default straight projectile.

milestones.name: Merge Special into Projectile
milestones.objective: Collapse Special class fields (gravity, explode, fuse) into Projectile. Delete Special class + specialPool. All flying entities use one class, one pool.
milestones.success: Special class deleted. specialPool deleted. All references updated. Tests pass. No behavior change.
milestones.diagram:
graph TD
    A[Entity] --> B[Projectile]
    B --> C[thorn: gravity=0, type=null]
    B --> D[rock: gravity=800, type=null]
    B --> E[bomb: gravity=800, type=bomb]
    B --> F[saw: gravity=0, type=saw]
    G[specialPool DELETED] -.->|removed| B
    H[projectilePool] -->|single pool| B

tasks.name: Add gravity+bounce fields to Projectile
tasks.what: Add gravityValue, bounce, explode, fuseLabel fields to Projectile class. Move the gravity integration from Special.update() into Projectile.update().
tasks.why: Projectile needs to handle arcing motion natively so rock/bomb don't need a separate class.
acceptance: Projectile can arc when gravityValue > 0
Bounce behavior matches current Special behavior

tasks.name: Merge sprite pipeline into single path
tasks.what: Delete initRockSprites + initSpecialSprites. Add all types (rock_medium, rock_small, bomb, saw, etc) to a single SPRITE_TARGETS map. One init function loads all sheets.
tasks.why: Eliminates three separate sprite init paths. One call at boot loads everything.
acceptance: One init function replaces initProjectileSprites + initSpecialSprites + initRockSprites
All sprites load correctly at boot

tasks.name: Delete Special class + specialPool
tasks.what: Remove Special class, specialPool, and all references. Update collision handlers, update loop, attack theater, and tests to use Projectile/projectilePool exclusively.
tasks.why: Eliminates the dual-class confusion. One class, one pool, one code path.
acceptance: grep -r 'specialPool' returns 0 results
grep -r 'class Special' returns 0 results
All existing tests pass

tasks.name: Convert ballistic to projectile with gravity
tasks.what: Delete ballistic.js primitive. Add gravity+bounce params to projectile primitive. Update all macros that invoke 'ballistic' to invoke 'projectile' with gravity params.
tasks.why: One primitive for all flying entities. Gravity is a param, not a separate class.
acceptance: ballistic.js deleted or is a thin alias to projectile
All macros updated to invoke projectile with gravity
Attack theater still works for arcing shots

tasks.name: Make rock the default arcing projectile
tasks.what: Typeless Projectile with gravity > 0 renders rock_medium sprite (high-res) or rockDrawer primitive (low-res). Same as thorn is default for gravity = 0.
tasks.why: Rock is a basic projectile, not a special. Default look for arcing typeless shots.
acceptance: Typeless Projectile with gravity shows rock sprite in high-res
Typeless Projectile with gravity shows rockDrawer in low-res
No outline on rock (thickness 0)

milestones.name: Per-type Outline Config
milestones.objective: Read outline thickness from sheet JSON. Each type declares its own outline (thorn=2, bomb=2, rock=0, etc). No hardcoded values in code.
milestones.success: Changing a sheet's outline field changes the rendered outline without code changes.
milestones.diagram:
graph LR
    A[sheet.json] --> B[parseSheet]
    B --> C[Projectile constructor]
    C --> D[spriteOutline with configured thickness]
    E[rock sheet outline 0] --> F[no outline rendered]

tasks.name: Read outline from sheet JSON
tasks.what: Add outline field to parseSheet output. Projectile constructor reads animData.outline (default 2) and passes to spriteOutline. Rock sheets declare outline: 0.
tasks.why: Per-type outline without code changes. Data-driven.
acceptance: parseSheet returns outline value from sheet JSON
Projectile uses configured thickness for spriteOutline
Rock renders with no outline, thorn/bomb with thickness 2

milestones.name: Unified Attack Invoke List
milestones.objective: Replace blastType/spawnType/weaponType with one param (child) referencing a shared ATTACK_IDS list. Eliminate duplicated if/else invoke chains across macros.
milestones.success: One ATTACK_IDS array. One param name. One invoke helper. All macros use the same list and same helper. Adding a new attack type requires zero macro changes.
milestones.diagram:
graph TD
    A[ATTACK_IDS list] --> B[spawnSplit: child=bomb]
    A --> C[skyMissile: child=napalm]
    A --> D[missileRain: child=mine]
    A --> E[clusterBomb: child=mine]
    B --> F[invoke child params ctx]
    C --> F
    D --> F
    E --> F
    F --> G[target primitive or macro]

tasks.name: Define ATTACK_IDS + invokeChild helper
tasks.what: Create shared ATTACK_IDS frozen array (all invocable attack ids). Create invokeChild(type, params, ctx) helper that maps type to the right invoke call. Place in engine.js or a new attacks-registry.js.
tasks.why: Single source of truth for all invocable attacks. One helper replaces 5-6 duplicated if/else chains.
acceptance: ATTACK_IDS contains all currently invocable attack ids
invokeChild delegates to engine.invoke correctly

tasks.name: Rename blastType/spawnType to child in all macros
tasks.what: Replace blastType, spawnType, weaponType params with single 'child' param across spawnSplit, clusterBomb, missileRain, skyMissile, reticleShot. Update TWEAKABLE lists in attack-theater.js.
tasks.why: One param name everywhere. No more confusion between 4 different names for the same concept.
acceptance: grep -r 'blastType|spawnType' returns 0 results in macros/
All macros use 'child' param
Theater param panels updated

tasks.name: Replace if/else chains with invokeChild
tasks.what: Replace all if/else if chains that map type strings to invoke calls with a single invokeChild(p.child, params, ctx) call. Remove duplicated mapping logic from each macro.
tasks.why: Eliminates 5-6 copies of the same switch logic. Adding a new attack type requires zero macro changes.
acceptance: No if/else chains mapping type strings to invoke calls remain in macros
All child materialization goes through invokeChild()
Existing tests pass
